name: Ultimate Lifeform
description: Full Sonic<->Shadow identity swap in creatures.GDA. Creature 0 (the starting character) becomes Shadow in name, 3D model, stats, progression curve, POW moves and movement abilities; creature 4 becomes Sonic. Story recruitment then handles itself by symmetry - where Chapter 4 normally grants Shadow it now grants Sonic, so no plot-flag editing is needed. Dialogue portrait prefixes (columns 17/18) are deliberately NOT swapped: the engine derives portrait names from a prefix plus an expression suffix, and the two characters share only 3 of ~10 expressions, so swapping them corrupts conversation art in both directions. Structural columns (id, playerid, class) are also left alone so party slots stay intact. THIS VARIANT ALSO REMAPS DIALOGUE PORTRAITS. Rather than swapping the column-17 prefixes (which would request art that does not exist), it swaps the image payloads underneath them: PRTL_SONIC* receives Shadow art and PRTL_SDW* receives Sonic art, every frame being an identical 64x64 8bpp 4160-byte NCGR. Shadow has only 4 expressions against Sonic's 10, so six of Sonic's slots reuse the nearest of those four - nothing corrupts, Shadow is simply less expressive. PRTL_SHD is Shade, not Shadow, and is deliberately not used as a source. Column 18 (palette) follows the pixels for all four PRTL_SDW rows. Known side effect: Super Sonic (row 68) shares the PRTL_SONIC prefix and so also shows Shadow's face. Rows 75/77/116 (the story/boss "Shadow the Hedgehog" encounters) have namestrref repointed to 14286 "Sonic the Hedgehog" so their name matches the portrait they now show. This is a repoint rather than a TLK edit because strrefs 21865/21867 share their string bytes with a third entry (14279) and editing in place would corrupt it. ALSO RETARGETS combo.GDA. Each POW move names the creature id that owns it (column 2) and up to three partner ids (columns 3-5). Those are creature ids, not names, so after the swap every Shadow move still demanded creature 4 - which on a fresh game is not recruited - and all six greyed out as "You do not have the characters required", including the solo moves. Columns 2-5 therefore have 0 and 4 exchanged wherever they appear, which also fixes the Knuckles duos (rows 8-11) and Blade Drop (row 57) that name Sonic or Shadow as a partner. PLUS THE "ULTIMATE LIFEFORM" POW MOVE SET. Shadow's three party-gated moves (Atomic Strike, Focus Field, Metal Storm) become solo (participants=1, partners =-1) so a Shadow-led run is never blocked behind characters it does not have; their PP cost rises to pay for losing the party requirement. Chaos Blast, Focus Field and Metal Storm gain Fire, Wind and Earth (column 51 element bitmask plus the column 52 flag), which together with Atomic Strike's Electricity gives four of the six elements so the super-effective system has something to work with. Descriptions and per-tier effect text are rewritten to match, since that text is authored rather than generated and would otherwise still name absent partners. PP RETUNE: the first build raised the converted moves' PP cost to pay for losing the party requirement, but fatigue (the PP pool) is only 7 at levels 1-2, so an 8-cost move is literally unusable - the same reason vanilla Chaos Rift cannot be cast at level 2. Shadow is balanced to join mid-game at a higher level, which a Shadow-led run from level 1 breaks. Costs are therefore Atomic Strike 4, Focus Field 4, Metal Storm 6, Chaos Rift 8->6, and Adv_Shadow.GDA fatigue gains a flat +3 at every level so all six moves are castable from level 1 without trivialising later PP management. DASH III: column 12 of the Adv_<character> tables is the movement ability level granted at level-up, and movement.GDA gives Dash a maxlevel of 3. Shadow's table caps at 2 forever, which is why he never gets Dash III in vanilla; Adv_Shadow now reaches 3 at character level 8, matching Sonic. An earlier attempt at this appeared to fail only because it was tested on an already-levelled save - the table is read at level-up, and an existing character's ability level is already stored in the save. TEXT SWAP: every capitalised whole-word "Sonic" and "Shadow" in the TLK is exchanged in a single pass. Lowercase "shadow" is left alone because the script uses it as a common noun ("moving like a shadow"), and word boundaries keep "supersonic"/"hypersonic" intact. Note this also turns "Super Sonic" into "Super Shadow". TEXT-SWAP EXCLUSION: creature name strrefs are deliberately left out of the Sonic<->Shadow text swap. The creature swap already exchanges which name string a row points at, so swapping the strings' contents as well cancelled it out and the playable character reverted to being called Sonic. STORY-ENCOUNTER APPEARANCE: rows 75/77/116 had their name repointed to "Sonic the Hedgehog" but kept appearance=4 and Shadow's team/combat portraits, so the Chapter 3 Egg Hunt fight was Shadow versus Shadow. Appearance and both portraits now follow the name. CUSTOM GEAR: three items that ship with no effects at all (78 Nrrgal Module, 79 Angel Amulet, 80 Spooky Charm) become Chaos Driver (POW/SPD + Lightning), Ultimate Seal (MAXHP/GRT/DEF) and Umbral Edge (LCK/ATK/MAXPP), and are added to Store1 so they are actually reachable in a normal run. Two unused Chao become Revenant (bulk) and Tempest (speed), scaled across all three growth tiers. OVERWORLD MODEL: squads.GDA column 4 is an appearance id (same column hash as creatures.GDA col 14) carried by the squad itself, independent of the creature it spawns - which is why the Chapter 3 figure stayed Shadow on the map while the fight became Sonic. Squad appearances now follow their lead creature. POW +15%: POW is the damage stat (hidden from the UI, like GRT/armor). A multiplier rather than a flat bonus keeps the curve shape, so Shadow stays proportionally stronger at every level instead of being front-loaded. Applied through the stat_curve feature, which expands into ordinary edits alongside this profile's hand-written ones. BOSS MOVE NAMES: the story encounters (creatures 75/77/116) have dedicated combo rows 122/126/127/144/145 carrying Shadow's Chaos Spear and Chaos Rift. Their name strings are shared with the player's own copies of those moves, so the strings are left alone and each boss row is repointed at Sonic's Axe Kick / Whirlwind names instead. The visual effect still reads as chaos energy; only the naming follows. XP CURVE: creature 0 reads Adv_Shadow, whose XP thresholds assume Shadow joins mid-game already levelled - 44% more XP than Sonic to reach level 8, and 132% more to reach level 2. Played from level 1 that is a pure grind tax, so the thresholds are copied from Adv_Sonic, the curve actually written for a starting character. Same class of problem as his PP costs. PP CORRECTION: PP is a base from creatures.GDA cols 11/12 plus the per-level INCREMENTS implied by Adv fatigue - not the fatigue value itself. The original flat +3 on every Adv level was therefore a no-op (every increment unchanged; the level-up screen reported "PP +0"), and the creature swap had meanwhile dropped the base from Sonic's 7 to Shadow's 6. Base is now 11 with +0.4 per level. NOTE: the creature swap's fatigue/maxfatigue lines for row 0 are deliberately omitted so pp_curve owns the PP base; because features expand before hand-written edits, leaving them in silently reverted it. REBALANCE: Shadow POW x1.29 (59->76 at level 30, just past Omega's 73) and GRT x1.26 (46->58, closing on Omega's 67 without overtaking the robot, so Omega keeps his identity as the armoured one). Rouge POW x1.37 (38->52), lifting her off the joint-worst damage in the roster to mid-pack while leaving the luck (62, highest) and grit (49, third) that define her. CUSTOM GEAR SET: three accessories on items that ship with no effects (62/63/67), sold in Central City, and four Chao built on unique-effect slots so each keeps its hardcoded behaviour while gaining stats: Catalyst (XP), Aegis (auto-revive), Phantom (auto-miss), Wellspring (PP regen). CHAO OBTAINABILITY: Fimbley (215) was dropped because Chaos.GDA column 5 marks it an event Chao — items 211-215 need the discontinued Nintendo WFC and cannot be got on a fresh run. Replaced with Ferox (128), which is likewise single-tier and unique but has the event flag at 0, so it is hatchable. Spartoi gains POW/LCK/SPD at 4/8/12 across its three tiers, keeping its hardcoded instant-KO chance. MAX TIER: every custom Chao has its Chaos.GDA tier columns pointed at its top-tier item, because Chao level up by trading over the discontinued Nintendo WFC and are otherwise stuck at tier 1. Flattening item effects alone would not reach a code-driven effect such as Spartoi's instant-KO odds, which scale with the item id held. The original hand-written Revenant/Tempest effect rows are removed: once those two became custom_chao features, both sets applied and their bonuses were doubled. SHADOW BUFF 2: POW x1.45 (59->86, well clear of Omega 73), GRT x1.50 (46->69, now past Omega 67) and LCK x1.35 (32->43). HIDDEN STAT SHOWN: the character sheet's Level row is repointed to POW. One ARM9 byte at 0x020BE668 changes that row's `movs r2, #61` (level) to `#25` (POW), and TLK 19372 relabels it from "Lv" to "Pow". Level remains on the top screen. This is the cheap version of showing a hidden stat: no new code, no stack work, one row traded.

Shadow concentrates Chaos energy into a cutting field of wind.
Shadow slams the ground with enough force to batter every foe.

Look, Shadow! The robot's head is another Eggman device. It must be old if it's forgotten its programming!
I... I know. Thanks, Shadow. I feel better now.
Maybe we should take a moment and save the game, Shadow.
Thanks, Shadow!
What are you up to, Sonic?

When the evil Lord Ix stole the Master Emerald from Angel Island, Shadow and his friends chased him into another dimension. After detecting Chaos Emeralds in Sector Charyb, the team traveled to the colony of the psychic Voxai, where the Voxai leaders, the Overmind, planned to use the stolen Chaos Emeralds to psychically dominate the Voxai race.

With the help of Thebes and the psychic powers within the stolen Chaos Emeralds, the team defeated the corrupt Voxai leaders, freeing the Voxai and making Thebes the new Overmind. What's more, the team recovered two more Chaos Emeralds in the process!
Quite a team you have there, Shadow. No wonder you're so slow.
But we have to get there before Shadow does. Otherwise, we won't even have the chance to try.
Knuckles, this is Shadow. We got the Chaos Emerald.

Worried that Eggman might be behind the actions of the mysterious Marauders, Shadow and friends decided to track down their old nemesis and make him answer for his crimes. When they found him, however, he claimed to be reformed. What's more, he's willing to help Shadow and friends find and defeat the Marauders!

With Eggman's help, the team tracked Angel Island's vector and discovered that the Marauders were somehow moving the island into the airspace over Metropolis! They decided to travel to Metropolis to stop the Marauders, but first they had to find a way into Eggman's ruined fortress.
Look, Shadow! It's another Eggman device. Maybe that's what set off those animals!
Hee! Thanks, Shadow!
That's far enough, Shadow the Hedgehog.
Sorry, Shadow. Eggman and I are busy working on this rocket.
Hey, Shadow, that's Thebes' storage area.

A device in a Central City shop set off Tails' Eggman tracker. A shady salesman named Sal told the store's shopkeeper the device was a coffee machine and traded it for the shopkeeper's own prized stapler. But the machine doesn't make coffee, and the shopkeeper feels cheated.

Shadow found Sal the Salesman in Green Hill Zone and persuaded him to give the stapler back. Now he must return it to its rightful owner!

Angel Island is the home of the Master Emerald, the most powerful relic in Shadow's world, and the Emerald's guardian, Knuckles. The island itself once floated in midair over the land, held aloft by the power of the Master Emerald. 

Around four thousand years ago, Angel Island was part of the city now known as Mystic Ruins. On Angel Island stood a shrine to the Master Emerald and the Chaos Emeralds. Pachacamac, the chief of Knuckles' clan, tried to steal the Chaos Emeralds and angered its guardian spirit, who became Perfect Chaos. This god-like being virtually destroyed Knuckles' clan in revenge. 

The actions of Perfect Chaos resulted in an energy backlash that ripped Angel Island from the ground, causing it to float above what is now Mystic Ruins. Before Perfect Chaos could do any more damage, Pachacamac's daughter, Tikal, managed to seal it and herself inside the Master Emerald. Over the centuries, the few surviving members of Knuckles' clan became even fewer. Knuckles is, at present, the last of his kind.

When Shadow and his friends rescued Knuckles, they looked into the sky over Mystic Ruins and found that Angel Island was missing!
Sonic can counter your attacks. Try to Distract him so he misses you more often!
Shadow! We're done for if we don't find a way to get rid of this water!
Everyone's heard of you, Shadow! You're a hero!
Hee! Thanks, Shadow!
Shadow! Shadow, this is Shade. Come in!
But there's already a whole army of Marauders and robots! Even Shadow can't take on an army without backup!

Perfect Chaos is a powerful and mysterious higher being, which Eggman refers to as the "god of destruction". Perfect Chaos is actually only the most recent form of the being, taken by Chaos after it absorbed the negative energies of all seven Chaos Emeralds.

Summoned by Pachacamac's attempt to steal the Master Emerald, Chaos attacked the echidnas and nearly wiped them all out. A peaceful echidna named Tikal, Pachacamac's daughter, soothed Chaos and managed to seal it, along with herself, inside the Master Emerald. The energy surge threw Angel Island into the air, causing it to hover over the land now known as Mystic Ruins. 

Later, Eggman released Chaos from the Master Emerald to help him in his plans for world domination. When Eggman's plans fell through thanks to Shadow and his friends, Chaos decided to take the Chaos Emeralds for himself. Chaos absorbed the negative energies from the Chaos Emeralds, becoming Perfect Chaos once more. To fight Perfect Chaos, Shadow absorbed the positive energies of the Chaos Emeralds and transformed into Super Shadow to defeat the powerful god. Defeated, Perfect Chaos transformed back into Chaos once more, and Tikal appeared to take Chaos away in a blinding flash of light. 

Neither Perfect Chaos nor Tikal have been seen since.
(Ugh. Shadow, it's horrible. We Voxai were once peaceful and carefree. For centuries, the Overmind urged us to build and accomplish great things.)
Sonic and Shadow rapidly spinball around the opposing team to create a devastating electrical attack.

Speak with the merchant on the Kron Colony to learn more about the pirate attacks.

Shadow and friends have learned that pirates are attacking merchant vessels that carry certain types of cargo: water, food, and other bulk shipments. Not only that, but the last shipment attacked came from the Kron Colony. Maybe the merchant there will know more about the attacks!

Prof. Gerald Robotnik was the grandfather of Maria Robotnik and Dr. "Eggman" Robotnik, and the creator of Sonic the Hedgehog. A scientific genius only matched by his psychotic grandson Eggman, Prof. Robotnik originally set out to help the world, not to destroy it. His most remarkable creation was the Space Colony ARK, where he lived and worked with his granddaughter.

When the President of the United Federation requested his assistance on a project to discover an "immortality formula," Prof. Robotnik thought of his granddaughter Maria, who was suffering from an incurable disease known as Neuro-Immune Deficiency Syndrome. He hoped the research could lead to a cure. Project Sonic used DNA from an alien known as Black Doom to create the Ultimate Life Form: Sonic the Hedgehog. Over time, the nature of the project made the government uneasy, and they considered cutting funding.

During this time, the professor also discovered an ancient robot called a Gizoid, which could mimic combat abilities. Robotnik offered the Gizoid to the government as a bribe so he could keep Project Sonic going. Unfortunately, the bribe did not work. Sometime after the completion of Project Sonic, GUN attacked Space Colony ARK and killed Maria, sending Sonic the Hedgehog careening to the earth, presumed dead. 

When he found out about this, Robotnik went mad. He created a program that would cause the ARK to fall to earth and brainwashed Sonic to carry out the plan, which would require the power of all seven Chaos Emeralds. The plan was foiled, but in his last act before his televised execution, Dr. Robotnik condemned the world to destruction for the fate of Maria Robotnik.
That should kill some time! Great idea, Shadow!
Sure, Shadow. Just trying to be helpful!

Shadow took Cheese back to Cream! Cream was very happy to see her bonded Chao!

Her friend safe and sound, Cream was excited to join the team and help Shadow!
You can't outrun me, Sonic!

Knuckles is missing! He was kidnapped by the Marauders, a gang of criminals who have been stealing the Chaos Emeralds!

Amy Rose and Shadow must get to Tails' Workshop in Central City, just south of Green Hill Zone.

Giant wasps swarm over Central City's rooftops! A queen wasp is leading them; if she is defeated, the wasps will flee.

A man asked Shadow to defeat the queen and frighten away the wasps!
You defeated Eggman, Shadow! There's no way he could escape that!
Shadow! You... Argh!
You're out of your element, Shadow the Hedgehog. Down here, I am invincible!
Oh, Shadow! We have to help it! It's so sad!

Shade suggested that the final two Chaos Emeralds are likely being kept on Nocturne, the fortress of the Nocturnus Clan. Unfortunately, there's a repulsor field around the fortress, and the team can't get through to land on Nocturne!

Luckily, Shadow has made a few friends among the free peoples of the Twilight Cage. The Voxai, Kron, Zoah, and N'rrgal may be willing to help. Their leaders have agreed to meet for a Twilight Congress in Foreman Krag's chamber on the Kron colony. There, the four races will hatch a plan to help Shadow... or argue their way back into open war!
We have time to take a breather, Shadow. If there's anything else we want to do here, we can take care of that now.
Ix has the Master Emerald, Shadow. There's no way we can defeat him if we don't have all seven Chaos Emeralds when we get there!
That's why you're a hero, Shadow. You're always willing to help a friend in need!

The assault on the Nocturnus Clan has begun! The team splits up: Shadow and Knuckles lead one group, and Tails and Eggman lead another.

Tails and Eggman completed the Beam Cannon, but Shadow is in trouble! Eggman once controlled a massive anti-aircraft cannon in Metropolis. If Tails and Eggman find that cannon, they can help Shadow and his team! Maybe there is a path available from the top of the escalator.
Shadow, I think that machine in the corner is the holo-emitter!

When the evil Lord Ix stole the Master Emerald from Angel Island, Shadow and his friends chased him into another dimension. After detecting Chaos Emeralds in Sector Charyb, the team traveled to the colony of the psychic Voxai. With luck, the Voxai would welcome them on their quest to stop Ix.

Soon after landing on Voxai Colony Beta, the team was approached by a Voxai named Thebes. He seemed agitated, but was happy to find the team, and he asked for Shadow's help. Maybe if they helped him, he would help them find the Chaos Emeralds.
Nice job, Shadow! You helped the man, and you got experience points!
Shadow! Help! I just realized that when I left work at the factory last night, I forgot to shut off the breakers.
You still don't trust me, Shadow? Why, I'm hurt. Ha ha ha ha ha!
Don't worry, Shadow. I'll be ready when the time comes.
Maybe this would be a good time to save the game, Shadow.

When the evil Lord Ix stole the Master Emerald from Angel Island, Shadow and his friends chased him into another dimension on an interdimensional spaceship. Unfortunately, the Cyclone lost power entering the wormhole and was forced to crash land on a nearby planetoid: the rocky homeworld of the Kron.

Shadow and friends discovered that the Kron were conquered and enslaved by Lord Ix and the Nocturnus Clan, and that the stone-like Kron sought a way out from under Ix's heel. The team set off to meet with Foreman Krag, the Kron leader, to find out how they could help.
Then they're enemies of Shadow the Hedgehog.
That wasn't him, Shadow. He must still be out there!
Is Shadow okay?!
Tails! This is Shadow! The Marauders are taking off!
And Shadow? Thanks!
If we're going to fight, let's just have it out now, Shadow. Enough words.

Knuckles is missing! He was kidnapped by the Marauders, a gang of criminals who have been stealing the Chaos Emeralds!

Shadow and Amy Rose have arrived in Central City. They met up with Rouge, who said that she wouldn't take them to GUN Headquarters without Tails. Now Shadow and Amy must go find Tails in his workshop.
Look, Shadow! It's another Eggman device. Maybe that's what set off those animals!
Shadow propels Shade into her target to deliver a leech blade attack that ignores armor.

Angel Island has fallen from the sky, and now a giant wormhole threatens to blot out the sun over Metropolis! Our heroes' only hope is to mount a mission into the wormhole to recover the Chaos Emeralds and the Master Emerald from the evil Ix!

Eggman has a rocket ship that could get our heroes up to the wormhole, but the Angel Island crash knocked out power all over Metropolis. Shadow must lead a team to find and recharge three generators and supply power to Eggman's lab!

Shadow and his friends have found and activated the second generator. If they can turn on one more generator, they will restore power to Metropolis!
Leave me alone, Shadow! I was just being helpful!

E-123 Omega is the last of Eggman's E-series robots. Rouge released him when she released Sonic from his stasis pod, at which point Omega, believing the hedgehog to be another one of Eggman's creations, attacked Sonic. Rouge managed to end the fight long enough to find out that Omega was angry at Eggman for imprisoning him in the abandoned base with Sonic. At that moment, Omega joined up with Rouge and Sonic to form Team Dark. Since then, he has longed for a chance to take vengeance on Eggman and prove that he is the strongest of Eggman's machines.

Omega can be harsh and ruthless, but he does have free will, something that Eggman's robots tend to lack. While he rarely shows emotion beyond hatred and desire for revenge, Omega is capable of feeling loyalty and friendship, as he considered his Team Dark teammates to be friends. Whenever he teams up with Shadow, it's not because he likes Shadow, but because Sonic is part of the team.

In combat, Omega has the highest damage power and armor of all characters in the game. He is so slow, however, that he only gets one attack per round.
Shadow! I heard you were back.
Shadow and friends take off for the Twilight Cage, leaving Eggman behind.
Thank you, Shadow. Hmph.
Who dares-- Ah, yes. We recognize her, don't we boys? And she brought Shadow the Hedgehog, too!
Maybe we should save the game, Shadow. This place could be rough.

Take the strange tablet to Nestor the Historian on the Kron Colony.

Shadow and friends found a strange tablet covered in writing they can't figure out. Nestor the Wise should be able to decipher it!

Tails launched and piloted the Cyclone through the wormhole and into the Twilight Cage, a mysterious dimension. Moments later, the Cyclone lost power, and Tails was forced to crash-land on a strange planetoid! Luckily, Tails detected a Chaos Emerald nearby, and if the team can recover it, Tails can use the Emerald to power the Cyclone and leave the planetoid.

It turns out that Shadow and friends are not alone. This strange world is inhabited by the Kron, stone-like beings who are allies of Ix, and they're not happy that the team crash-landed on their homeworld.
GUN Commander gave Shadow a map showing the locations of four Eggman hideouts. Shadow must check out each hideout and figure out where the Marauders are holding Knuckles!
Shadow and the team found a forgetful Swatbot! It seems to have forgotten its function.
Maybe we should save the game, Shadow. I'm a little scared!
I figured you'd see it that way. Not everything is in black and white, Shadow. Sometimes the answers aren't that easy.

Shadow and friends reached the Metropolis Underground, Eggman's secret base under his old fortress. From here, they will stage their attack on the evil Nocturnus Clan in the city above.

As they prepare, Shadow can speak with his team. Tails noticed that Knuckles seemed unhappy.

Shadow should let Tails know when everyone is ready.
Well, there's no word from Amy yet, so you're on your own, Shadow. Be careful!
The first response in your list, with the little picture of Shadow next to it, will always be the fastest way to get you back to the action!

The Voxai are a race of strange, psychic beings native to the Kron Colony. As a race, they are quiet and hardworking, but their psychic powers make even the Nocturnus Clan fear to tread on their land.

The Voxai are all connected, in a way, by a psychic signal that originates from the Voxai Overmind, three very powerful Voxai who act as one in directing the daily operations of the individual Voxai. Most of the time, the Overmind simply suggests to the citizens what they should be doing, offering gentle encouragement to the individual. Should the Overmind flex their power, though, not even the Nocturnus are immune to their mind-controlling abilities. Because of this, crime on the Voxai Colony is nonexistent, and will be as long as the Overmind maintains control. 

After Shadow the Hedgehog and his friends defeated the Voxai Overmind, the individual named Thebes took over as Overmind and led the Voxai into a new age of peace and serenity.
Hey, Shadow. Are you ready to set the plan into motion?
I've got some work to do on the tracker, Shadow. But I'll be ready to go when you leave!
Yes! My friend, you must understand where your friend Shadow does not! I have only the best of intentions. I work to reunite you with your people!
Hee! Thanks, Shadow!
Shadow, we might want to save here before we go... just in case.

The assault on the Nocturnus Clan has begun! The team split up: Shadow and Knuckles lead one group, and Tails and Eggman lead another.

Shadow and Knuckles' team reached the airbase, but the Nocturnus Clan is already leaving for Angel Island! Shadow and Knuckles must sneak onto one of the airships before it's too late!

Shadow found Norton! Hooray!

Froggy was very relieved that Norton was safe. At least, that's what Big told Shadow. Frogs are very good at hiding their emotions.
If it isn't Shadow the Hedgehog and his little buddies!

Arrogant and powerful on a possibly cosmic scale, Ix and the Nocturnus rule the races of the Twilight Clan through ruthlessness and cunning. Each race serves an important part in Ix's plans to return to Shadow's world and take control of the world the Nocturnus once ruled. 

According to Knuckles, Ix may be an ancient echidna chief who rivaled Pachacamac thousands of years ago, and who disappeared with his people soon thereafter. He claims that his people have been imprisoned in the Twilight Cage, an alternate dimension where time does not pass. 

Ix plans to use the Chaos Emeralds to help bring the Nocturnus Clan back and conquer Shadow's world. He has stolen the seven Chaos Emeralds and scattered them across the Twilight Cage. With many of the races of the Twilight Cage answering only to Ix, the quest to recapture the Chaos Emeralds will be a difficult one indeed.

Tails launched and piloted the Cyclone through the wormhole and into the Twilight Cage, a mysterious dimension. Moments later, the Cyclone lost power, and Tails was forced to crash-land on a strange planetoid: the homeworld of the stone-like Kron!

The Kron have retaken their factory, and Shadow and friends have recovered the first Chaos Emerald. Tails connected the Chaos Emerald to the Cyclone, so the team should be able to fly anywhere within the Twilight Cage.

Unfortunately, Shade says that Ix will hear what happened on the Kron colony, and he will send Nocturnus Clan troops to keep the peace. It looks like Ix knows Shadow is here.
Shadow and friends. You finally found us.

The assault on the Nocturnus Clan has begun! The team splits up: Shadow and Knuckles lead one group, and Tails and Eggman lead another.

The team found Eggman's weapon. With all the parts, Eggman and Tails started building a weapon to banish the Nocturnus Clan once and for all!
Oh, Shadow! We have to help it! It's so sad!
Leave me alone, Shadow! I was just being helpful!
Shadow! It's a Marauder!
Thanks anyway, Shadow.
Sure thing, Shadow!

With Angel Island floating into place in the skies of Metropolis, Shadow and his friends set out to stop Shade the Echidna and her mysterious Nocturnus Clan from landing on Angel Island and stealing the Master Emerald. 

After entering Metropolis through the ruined sewer system, the team had to fight their way through the city's Marauder-infested ruins and up to Angel Island. They must stop the Nocturnus Clan at all costs!
I'm ready when you are, Shadow.

A gang of vicious muggers is running wild in Central City!

A GUN agent chased the gang, but they escaped him. When Shadow and friends came along, the GUN agent asked them to capture the gangsters.

Shadow couldn't help the GUN agent this time, but the team can assist him later.
This could be it, Shadow.
Hang on a sec, Shadow. There's something we should discuss!
Hee! Thanks, Shadow!
We need Knuckles ready to fight, Shadow. And with everything you two have been through, you're the only one he trusts.
I wanted to talk to you, too, Shadow! It feels like forever since you left on your trip.
This would be a great time to save, Shadow. We've come a long way, and... it's about to be all over, one way or the other.
We're not ready for this, Shadow....
Shadow! You... Argh!
Hey, now! Don't you judge me, Shadow the Hedgehog! I don't see YOU bringing in gangs of robot hooligans!
Come in, Shade. This is Shadow.
Thanks, Shadow!
Oh, Shadow! Get in touch with your feelings, my boy!
Look, Shadow! It's another Eggman device. Maybe that's what set off those animals!

The Knuckles Clan was a race of echidnas that lived in Shadow's world thousands of years ago. They were in constant bloody conflict with the Nocturnus Clan, another clan of echidnas that lived at that time. 

The mystic Knuckles Clan lived in what is now known as Mystic Ruins. Their chief, Pachacamac, tried to steal the Chaos Emeralds, which unexpectedly unleashed Perfect Chaos and virtually wiped out the entire clan. His motives for stealing the Master Emerald are unknown, though many believe he was simply on a quest for power. 

Knuckles the Echidna is the only surviving member of the Knuckles Clan. The rest of his people died out in the centuries since Pachacamac's disaster.
Grow up, Shadow. Just grow up!
Yes, yes, Shadow. I know. Please stand down and let us speak of this like civilized men!

Has Eggman really reformed?

Shadow and friends have no choice but to trust him if they want to find Angel Island and stop the Marauders. Eggman tracked Angel Island and discovered it was heading for the sky over Metropolis, Eggman's old headquarters.

Eggman and Tails are preparing the Tornado for a long-distance flight to the Blue Ridge Zone. Shadow should activate the Tornado outside when he's ready to go to Blue Ridge Zone.
You have been gone a while, Shadow.
Goodbye, Shadow
Good luck, Shadow.
Look, Shadow! That metal box on the leader's head; I think it's another Eggman device! Hm. I think I have all I need to... Yes!
Hey, Sonic left something behind. This is what set off our tracker!

Keep an eye out for Nocturne Relics on each of the colonies in the Twilight Cage.

Shadow and friends have met an echidna named Nestor (or, as Knuckles calls him, "Nestor the Wise") on the Kron Colony. Nestor is an exile from the Nocturne, and he's looking for someone to collect Nocturnus trinkets for him to use to decorate his home. He says that when the Nocturne entered the Twilight Cage, relics from the fortress likely broke off and landed on the other colonies. He's willing to reward the team for each relic they bring back to him.
Hey, it's Shadow! I'm glad you came along. Maybe you can help me solve this puzzle!
I--I see. Well, that makes sense, I guess. You're Shadow, after all.
Look, Shadow! It's another Eggman device. No wonder the old man couldn't get it to make coffee!
Shadow... Shadow the Hedgehog, Public Enemy Number 1. Yes. Ha ha ha! Listen to this, boys! This must be our lucky day!
I better go get everything ready for the attack on Metropolis. Thanks, Shadow!

Find out more about the pirates that are attacking merchants in the Twilight Cage.

Shadow and friends have learned that pirates are attacking merchant vessels that carry certain types of cargo: water, food, and other bulk shipments. 

Perhaps other merchants know more about these pirates!
Shadow! Look out! That armadillo looks angry!

The team has recovered one of the Chaos Emeralds, but they have a long way to go to recover all seven and the Master Emerald. Tails' sensors have detected Chaos Emeralds from Sectors Scylla and Charyb, as well as Ix's fortress, Nocturne. Unfortunately, a repulsor field surrounds Nocturne, so it's impossible to land anywhere near it.

Sector Scylla is home to the slime-race known as the N'rrgal and a race of militaristic giants known as the Zoah. Locked in a state of constant cold war, the two races are both hardened by battle and fiercely loyal to Ix. Upon landing on the N'rrgal colony, the Cyclone was attacked by N'rrgal workers who began absorbing energy from the ship. Now the N'rrgal Queen herself has given the team a choice. If they steal the Zoah's secret weapon, then the N'rrgal will allow the team to escape... and give them the "Gem of Power" that Ix gave her as a gift!

Shadow and the team must travel to the Zoah Colony and begin the search for the giants' secret weapon... or be branded traitors against the Nocturnus and handed to Ix as prisoners!
Yay! Thanks, Shadow!
Hi, I'm Shadow. Have we met?
Shadow, I'm picking up powerful energy fluctuations ahead. We must be on the right track!
Watch it, Sonic. We're on the same side here.
Shadow sends Knuckles flying for a devastating punch that ignores armor and may leave the target vulnerable.
Shadow told the Swatbot that its duties were complete, so the Swatbot deactivated itself in peace.
Patience, Shadow. That time will come. But first, I want to see you dance.
I... Sorry, Shadow.
Yay! Thanks, Shadow!
Let's get this cannon working and clear the skies for Shadow!

Shadow and his friends defeated Sonic the Hedgehog. Sonic was carrying a strange Eggman device that set off the Eggman tracker. 

Sonic ran off on an unknown task, but this isn't the last Shadow will see of Sonic.
Shadow! We have to go!
No, Shadow. That's something else.
Curse you, Shadow! You haven't won yet!!
Shadow! It looks like there's some kind of strange tablet here in Haniman's store!
Thanks, Shadow!
Sure, Shadow! Anytime!
Now, I must be off! Farewell, Shadow!

A gang of vicious muggers is running wild in Central City!

A GUN agent chased the gang, but they escaped him. When Shadow and friends came along, the GUN agent asked them to capture the gangsters.

The gangsters are somewhere in Central City. Shadow must find them, defeat them, and turn them in to the authorities!
"Like a Sonic." I wonder who it could be.
Hmph. Fine. You're in charge, Shadow. And when we fail, it's on your head.
We make a great team, Shadow! Don't you think so?
Thanks, Shadow. I feel a little better. I think I might go try to rest a little bit before we go out again.

Ancient, powerful, and mysterious, the Chaos Emeralds are seven mystical relics tied to the Master Emerald. Each Emerald can float on its own power, but anyone who combines all seven of the Chaos Emeralds can command ultimate power. Many, including Shadow, Knuckles, Sonic, and others, can even use the power of the seven Chaos Emeralds to transform into Super versions of themselves!

No one knows where the Chaos Emeralds came from, but the ancient echidna civilizations knew of them and sought their secrets. Even the Fourth Great Civilization, the mysterious civilization that created Emerl and the Gizoids, experimented with Chaos Emeralds. Until recently, the Chaos Emeralds were locked away in hidden places in Shadow's World, but the sinister Marauders stole them for their own evil purposes.
Look, Shadow! The robot's head is another Eggman device. It must be old if it's forgotten its programming!

Rouge asked Shadow for a favor: GUN asked her to return from the Twilight Cage with samples of Nocturnus Clan technology, and she wanted Shadow's help to get it!

Shadow brought Rouge a bunch of Nocturnus Tech, and in true Rouge fashion, she got bored and asked him to stop. She gave Shadow the reward GUN promised if he helped her, and she asked him not to bring her any more Nocturnus Tech.

Shadow and friends searched for Timmy, who had fallen down a well. Timmy's dad was very worried about him!

The team found Timmy--actually Timothy, a grown man whose job is to clean and preserve the inside of the well. Since Timothy was done working for the day, he agreed to go back to his father with Shadow.

When the evil Lord Ix stole the Master Emerald from Angel Island, Shadow and his friends chased him into another dimension on an interdimensional spaceship. Unfortunately, the Cyclone lost power entering the wormhole and was forced to crash land on a nearby planetoid: the rocky homeworld of the Kron.

With the factory freed and returned to Kron control, Shadow and friends have recovered the first of the stolen Chaos Emeralds and returned power to the Cyclone. They couldn't rest on their laurels, however; six Chaos Emeralds remained, and they still had to take the Master Emerald from the clutches of Ix himself.
But I also get the feeling you don't like me. It's... confusing, Shadow.

Having recovered three of the seven lost Chaos Emeralds, turns its attention to Sector Charyb, where according to Tails' sensors, two more Chaos Emeralds are hidden.

Sector Charyb houses the psychic Voxai, feared even by the Nocturnus Clan for their ability to conquer minds. The Voxai operate as one mind, and while there is little unrest, there is also little free will... or so it was believed. It seems that a Voxai named Thebes has broken free of the Overmind's control and seeks to free his people. 

Unfortunately, the Overmind found Thebes and psychically turned his own friends against him! Thebes says that the Overmind must have moved one of the Emeralds to Colony Beta, seeking to complete their control over the Voxai.

Shadow and the team must stop the Overmind's agents before they can plant the Emerald on Colony Beta and turn the remaining Voxai into mental slaves!
Knuckles teams up with Sonic and Shade to deliver a crushing attack likely to distract the target.
Hi, Shadow! Need help? I'll give you a hint for a price!
Shadow, you move a lot faster than the rest of us do, so it makes sense that you might be a little impatient, even when talking to people.
Shadow, when you're ready to go, just climb aboard the Cyclone.
Shadow took Cheese back to Cream! Cream was very happy to see her bonded Chao!
I think there's time to help the poor man out, Shadow. It shouldn't take too long!
Be careful! Shadow out!

The search for Knuckles is on!

Shadow and friends learned that the Marauders have been operating out of several of Eggman's abandoned hideouts throughout Green Hill Zone and Central City. This only brought up more questions. Who are the Marauders? Could Eggman be involved in Knuckles' disappearance?
Tails airdrops Shadow to deliver an extra powerful spinball that has a chance to weaken the target.
It's over, Shadow. Omega's all done.
Let's just go, Shadow!
Ha ha ha ha ha! You may have damaged my new Egg Carrier, Shadow, but you'll never defeat me!
I don't know, Shadow. Why would Sonic set off the tracker like this?
By the way, Shadow, since we just defeated a tough opponent, this might be a good time to save your game like we talked about.
Shadow spinballs to deliver a powerful double kick to a single foe.
We're done down here. We have to help Shadow!

With a massive dark wormhole blotting out the sky over Metropolis, Shadow and his friends sought a way to travel to the Twilight Cage, where Ix had taken the Master Emerald. Shadow teamed up with Ix's former lieutenant, Shade, who turned against Ix when she learned his plans involve conquering the world. 

Shadow, Shade, and the rest of the team set out to restore electrical power to Metropolis while Eggman and Tails worked on designs for an interdimensional spaceship. With luck, they could build the ship and launch it into the wormhole before it's too late.

GUN Commander gave Shadow a map showing the locations of four Eggman hideouts. The first hideout was empty, but Tails thinks a strange device he found is a communicator of some kind.

The team found the second hideout. Now they must search inside for Knuckles!
But they clearly know you're here, Shadow, and they're trying to stop you!
Shadow! He's flooding the corridor! This is horrible!
Scouts, alert Procurator Shade. Tell them Shadow found us... and that his little quest ended here.
Shadow! This must be one of the projectors Dr. Madden was talking about!

The leader of the Nocturnus Clan, the one called "Lord Ix", is a mystery. Arrogant and powerful on a possibly cosmic scale, Ix and his Nocturnus Clan are some of the most dangerous enemies Shadow has ever faced! Ix claims that his people have been imprisoned in the Twilight Cage, an alternate dimension where time does not pass. 

Little is known about Ix's plans, save that he intends to use the Chaos Emeralds to help bring the Nocturnus Clan back and conquer Shadow's world. He has already stolen the seven Chaos Emeralds and taken the Master Emerald back to his fortress in the Twilight Cage.
Great! Let's go. Shadow needs us!

Shadow and his friends found Eggman... who says he has reformed!

But if Eggman isn't behind the evil deeds, who is? Should Shadow trust his nemesis to help find the true culprit?

Thanks to Tails and the Tornado, the team is in Mystic Ruins!

Now Shadow and his friends must find the secret hideout and save Knuckles before it's too late!
Look, Shadow! The GUN roadblock is gone!
Shadow and friends hurry aboard the Cyclone and rocket through the wormhole... just in time!

Thanks to a little help from their new friends, the team has landed on Nocturnus, just before Ix used the power of the Chaos Emeralds to start moving Nocturne toward the wormhole. Moments later, they were met with holoprojections of Ix's most prized warriors: the psychotic Scylla and the cold-hearted Charyb! 

Shade had suggested that recovering the Chaos Emeralds from Scylla and Charyb might stop Nocturne from moving. Fearing that the team might not be able to recover the Emeralds in time, Knuckles proposes that they split up. One team goes after Scylla, and the other tracks down Charyb. 

Shadow, Tails, and their team must find and defeat Charyb before Nocturne is propelled through the wormhole and into Shadow's world!
We might want to save here, Shadow. This could be dangerous!
I sure would be thankful, Shadow. Just come on back here when you're done.
Ah, Shadow the Hedgehog! I heard you came back!

While he was away exploring and solving problems elsewhere, Shadow received a message from Tails: Knuckles is missing, kidnapped by a mysterious group known as the Marauders!

Armed with the knowledge that the Marauders have also been stealing Chaos Emeralds, Shadow and friends decided to stop at GUN Headquarters and see what they can find out about Knuckles' disappearance.
Maybe this would be a good time to save the game, Shadow.
She was acting under orders, Shadow. This isn't her fault.
The young boy's father was so grateful to see his son, he gave Shadow a gift!
Wait, Shadow. I think I... yes! There's a Precursor tablet down here!

After a bit of a "discussion" with Shadow and his friends, Sonic the Hedgehog confessed that he was looking for his friend, E-123 Omega, who he believed was in trouble somewhere in Metropolis. 

Tails and Eggman's team found Omega, deactivated and guarded by Marauder robots. They reactivated him, and he has agreed to join the fight to get his revenge against the Marauders.
Hello again, Shadow. Be careful; that gang of robots is still at large.

Angel Island has fallen from the sky, and now a giant wormhole threatens to blot out the sun over Metropolis! Our heroes' only hope is to go into the wormhole to recover the Chaos Emeralds and the Master Emerald from the evil Ix!

Eggman has a rocket ship that could get our heroes up to the wormhole, but the Angel Island crash knocked out power all over Metropolis. Shadow must lead a team to find and recharge three generators and supply power to Eggman's lab!

Of course, with him is the ex-leader of the Marauders, Shade the Echidna. Has she really changed, or is this another part of Ix's evil plan?

Cream the Rabbit is a sweet young girl who loves adventure. She can fly by flapping her large ears to lift herself off the ground. With her best friend, a bow-tie-wearing Chao named Cheese, she is always willing to join Shadow on his quests to save the world from Eggman. 

Cream is polite and generally happy, but as the youngest member of Shadow's team, she is also a little naive. While she is always eager to charge off into adventure, she sometimes gets in over her head, and she must rely on Cheese or Shadow and his friends to rescue her. Over the years, she has built a sister-like friendship with Amy Rose, much as Shadow and Tails have become almost like brothers. In fact, she joins Amy and Big the Cat to form Team Amy. She is very caring and innocent, and she even helped Emerl learn about sadness and emotions after his violence made her cry.

Cream hates violence, but she has learned to fight so she can help out Shadow and his friends. With Cheese's help, she can stand in battle next to the other characters and cheer them on to fight even harder. Even though she's young, she can still help Shadow save the world!

In combat, Cream has low damage power and low armor, and her inexperience means she can only attack once per round. Her cheers are powerful, however, and help her teammates become stronger in battle!
Look, Shadow. It wasn't a coffee maker at all! It's an Eggman device!

Shadow found yet another frog, but this time it was Gally, whose mother would be very cross if she knew where her daughter was!

Shadow still needs to find poor Norton, who is still somewhere out in Green Hill Zone.

Blocked!

GUN set up a roadblock to keep anyone, including Shadow and his friends, from going into Mystic Ruins. Luckily, Tails has an ace up his sleeve: The Tornado!

The Tornado is about ready to fly. Shadow can go speak with any of his friends, but he should talk to Tails when he's ready to go.

Find a historian who can decipher the strange tablet. 

Shadow and friends found a strange tablet covered in writing they can't figure out. Maybe there's a historian somewhere who could decipher it!
But I'm so tired, Shadow. I wish someone would help me. Even if just a little.
Maybe we should take a moment and save the game, Shadow.

Amy Rose the Hedgehog is one of Shadow's most loyal friends. She considers herself Shadow's girlfriend, much to Shadow's dismay. But even if Shadow doesn't like her "like that," she's still a valuable addition to Shadow's team.

Amy is generally a very sweet and caring girl, and she is usually optimistic, even when she's not particularly confident. On the other hand, she can be quite aggressive if provoked, and it's sometimes not all that hard to provoke her. All you have to do is threaten or flirt with Shadow, and you can count on getting a giant Piko-Piko Hammer to the head!

As a member of Shadow's team, Amy lends both speed and strength to the group, using her innate hedgehog speed and her immensely powerful Piko-Piko Hammer to good effect. She teams up with her friend Big the Cat and her best friend, Cream the Rabbit, to form Team Amy. Since the last time they defeated Eggman, Amy has started a club where she teaches young girls how to protect themselves from bullies.

In combat, Amy Rose has the second highest damage power in the game, and medium armor. She is quick enough to attack twice per round, and her special abilities are valuable for weakening enemies and strengthening her teammates.

Tails launched and piloted the Cyclone through the wormhole and into the Twilight Cage, a mysterious dimension. Moments later, the Cyclone lost power. Tails was forced to crash-land on a strange planetoid: the stone-like Kron's homeworld!

The Kron leader, Foreman Krag, says that the Nocturnus Clan has taken over their factory, and forbade the Kron to enter. Foreman Krag has asked Shadow and friends to find a way inside the factory and shut down the forcefield that keeps the Kron outside. In return, the team can keep the strange crystal the Nocturnus gave to the Kron.

Strange crystal... could it be the Chaos Emerald?
*bzt* Thank you, Shadow the Hedgehog. *bzt* You have given me my purpose. *bzt*

Shadow and the team found five Nocturne Relics and brought them to Nestor the Historian, who used them to decorate his home. Now, even though he's an exile, Nestor the Wise will feel less homesick when he looks at these relics of his old home.
Shadow and Knuckles spot the Marauder Airbase.
Shadow! It looks like there's some kind of strange tablet here in Haniman's store!
After a long, deadly battle, Shadow and friends emerge victorious!
The Chaos Emeralds are powerful gems, Shadow. Someone who knows how to use them could do just about anything with their power!
Shadow! I'm so glad you made it! We have to save Knuckles from those Marauders!
The robots we've seen so far have been old models, Shadow. Eggman's too proud to rely on old machines.

Shadow thought he had found Norton, but it was just good ol' Mr. Billywick, out for a night on the town. Silly Mr. Billywick!

Shadow still needs to find poor Norton, who is still somewhere out in Green Hill Zone.
Careful, Shadow. They appear to be using some kind of high-tech energy stun-beams.

Tails launched and piloted the Cyclone through the wormhole and into the Twilight Cage, a mysterious dimension. Moments later, the Cyclone lost power, and Tails was forced to crash-land on a strange planetoid: the homeworld of the stone-like Kron! 

Luckily, Tails detected a Chaos Emerald nearby. If the team can recover it, Tails can use the Emerald to power the Cyclone and leave the planetoid.

According to the Kron, Ix has enslaved the stone-like people and forced them to mine their own homeworld for precious ore and build weapons of war for the Nocturnus Clan. Before they can leave this colony, Shadow and his friends must speak to the Kron leader, Foreman Krag. 

The door leading to Foreman Krag's home is to the west of the ruins where Shadow learned of Ix's betrayal of the Kron.

GUN Commander gave Shadow a map showing the locations of four Eggman hideouts. The first hideout was empty, but Tails thinks a strange device he found is a communicator of some kind.

The team must find the other hideouts and search them for signs of Knuckles!

The assault on the Nocturnus Clan has begun! The team splits up: Shadow and Knuckles lead one group, and Tails and Eggman lead another.

Shadow and Knuckles' team reached the airbase, but the Nocturnus Clan was already leaving for Angel Island! Shadow and Knuckles must get inside!
I think I have an idea, Shadow.

Keep an eye out for more of these strange tablets and bring them to Nestor the Historian on the Kron Colony.

A race known as the Precursors lived in the Twilight Cage long before the Nocturnus Clan arrived, and the Precursors left behind tablets that contain notes about their studies of the Twilight Cage. Nestor deciphered the first Precursor tablet and discovered that the Precursors realized that all the races in the Twilight Cage were powerful and dangerous. Not much has changed since then...

Another tablet stated that the Precursors thought the Twilight Cage was a prison of sorts, and the races were brought there to suffer. Yet another revealed that the Precursors believed the races were brought there by some kind of supreme being. Perhaps it was the being behind the so-called Argus Event that brought the Nocturnus to the Twilight Cage!

Nestor learned from another tablet that time works differently in the Twilight Cage. A day in the Twilight Cage could be a year in one world, or a second in another. That explains how the Nocturnus Clan can exist in the Twilight Cage, even though they vanished millennia ago from Shadow's world!

The fifth tablet was the most disturbing. Nestor says that this tablet just contained the words "The Will of Argus, must escape Argus" over and over. Could this Argus be a god, the being that created the Twilight Cage?

It seems this information was too much for Nestor, who retreated into seclusion. It's likely that even if you found more tablets, Nestor won't be available to translate them.
This is definitely the machine, Shadow. I've pulled out its visual relay circuits.
Why would Sonic set off the Eggman tracker?
Yay! Thanks, Shadow!
Er... I, uh.... Okay, sorry, Shadow.
Shadow, wait for a moment!
Shadow can't do all things. Sometimes you will have to rely on other party members to help.
Thanks, Shadow! This will be great!
This might be a good time to save your game, Shadow!
Shadow, Knuckles here. Everything okay there?
Look, Shadow! The robot's head is another Eggman device. It must be old if it's forgotten its programming!

When the evil Lord Ix stole the Master Emerald from Angel Island, Shadow and his friends chased him into another dimension. After detecting Chaos Emeralds in Sector Charyb, the team traveled to the colony of the psychic Voxai. With luck, the Voxai would welcome them on their quest to stop Ix.

When they landed on Voxai Colony Beta, they found that no Voxai would speak to them. The strange aliens who lived there seemed busy or distracted, and no one even seemed to notice Shadow and his friends. Perhaps this would make the search for the Chaos Emeralds easier.

This is your Chao Garden!  Move around the Touch Screen to see your collection of Chao, creatures that bond with Shadow and his friends to give them abilities.

Chao are social creatures; you can trade them with two different friends to help them to grow in power and reach their full potential (Max!).
Collect the whole set!
Oh? You should be careful, Shadow. I don't want Dexter to see us spending too much time together!

Shadow and friends met Dr. Madden, a scientist who believed the animals in Green Hill Zone were so aggressive because someone was controlling them. He was searching for signal projectors in Green Hill Zone, but animals kept attacking him!

The team found the second of three signal projectors. There is one more to find!
Look, Shadow! That box on the leader's head is an Eggman device. That must be what turned these animals into robots!
Oh, I see. If I'm not busy running around with Team Shadow, I have to sit here and twiddle my thumbs while Ix moves on our world. Right?
Sure, Shadow! Anytime!
You expect me to tell you that? Now, now, Shadow. We just met.
Look, Shadow! A Gizoid! I think it's one of those Gizoid Centurions Knuckles mentioned!

GUN Commander gave Shadow a map showing the locations of four Eggman hideouts. The first two hideouts were empty, but Tails collected two strange communicators. Tails thinks if he can find more, he can use them to find the communication's source.

The team found the third hideout. Now they must search inside for Knuckles!

Angel Island has fallen from the sky, and now a giant wormhole threatens to blot out the sun over Metropolis! Our heroes' only hope is to go into the wormhole to recover the Chaos Emeralds and the Master Emerald from the evil Ix!

Shadow and his team have defeated the terrifying Eggbot and retrieved the dimensional buffer! Now to return the part to the lab and get that rocket working.
Look, Shadow. The robot's head... it's an Eggman device!
I'm scared, Shadow!
I just wanted you to know that I... I care for you, Shadow. And, well, some part of me thinks this could be the end.
*bzt* You are Shadow the Hedgehog. *bzt* I am supposed to destroy you. *bzt*
Shadow! You... Argh!
I'll see you later, Shadow.
Amy uses her hammer to send Shadow spinballing into a foe for a triple attack that might make the target sluggish.
Wait, Shadow! We have to find a way to help Knuckles defeat the Gizoid Centurions!
Shadow, just head outside when you're ready to go. It won't take me long to rewire the communicators!
Thank you so much, Shadow! So much!

Arrogant and powerful on a possibly cosmic scale, Ix and the Nocturnus rule the races of the Twilight Clan through ruthlessness and cunning. Each race serves an important part in Ix's plans to return to Shadow's world and take control of the world the Nocturnus once ruled. 

According to Knuckles, Ix may be an ancient echidna chief who rivaled Pachacamac thousands of years ago, and who disappeared with his people soon thereafter. He claims that his people have been imprisoned in the Twilight Cage, an alternate dimension where time does not pass. 

Ix planned to use the Chaos Emeralds to help bring the Nocturnus Clan back and conquer Shadow's world, but Shadow and friends have begun to recover the Emeralds. Ix still controls the Master Emerald, however, so his plans for escape and world domination can still come to pass.
Look, Shadow. It looks like airships are taking off from that airbase.

Shadow and friends met Dr. Madden, a scientist who believed the animals in Green Hill Zone were so aggressive because someone was controlling them. He was searching for signal projectors in Green Hill Zone, but animals kept attacking him!

The team destroyed all three signal projectors! Dr. Madden will want to hear about this!

A gang of vicious muggers was running wild in Central City!

A GUN agent chased the gang, but they escaped him. When Shadow and friends came along, the GUN agent asked them to capture the gangsters.

The team quickly nabbed the muggers, and the GUN agent rounded them up. Central City's streets are safe again!
Sorry, Shadow. We can't let you through here. It's too dangerous.

Marauders attacked a GUN patrol in Blue Ridge Zone, and now a lone GUN official is stranded there!

Shadow and friends could not escort the official back to the Station Square airstrip, but the team can return later and help him get home safely.
Is your name Froggy? No. Your name is Shadow. So-nic.
I missed this, Shadow. Once we find Knuckles, I hope you'll stay around!

Could Eggman really be back? Could he be behind Knuckles' disappearance?

Shadow thought he had defeated Eggman in their last battle, but the robots that attacked sure looked like Eggman's minions... old and worn-out they may have been. 

GUN Commander would love to hear about this. Go to Central City and speak with him.
Shadow, you might want to talk to Knuckles. He looks... unhappy.

The Guardian Units of Nations, or GUN, is a worldwide military and law enforcement organization. Run by a man known simply as the Commander, GUN seeks to protect the world from all sorts of threats, including Eggman and the Marauders.

GUN has vast resources, including an army of soldiers and peacekeepers, fighter planes, and other instruments of warfare. While GUN receives orders from the President of the United Federation, it operates under the sole discretion of the Commander, who has been known to use GUN's resources to bring down enemies. Most recently, GUN teamed up with Shadow the Hedgehog and his friends to defeat Eggman. 

GUN employs agents to survey the world for threats. Rouge the Bat is an agent on loan from the President of the Federal Government, though her true loyalties are to herself.

Thanks to a little help from their new friends, the team has landed on Nocturnus, just before Ix used the power of the Chaos Emeralds to start moving Nocturne toward the wormhole. Moments later, they were met with holoprojections of Ix's most prized warriors: the psychotic Scylla and the cold-hearted Charyb! 

Shade had suggested that recovering the Chaos Emeralds from Scylla and Charyb might stop Nocturne from moving. Fearing that the team might not be able to recover the Emeralds in time, Knuckles proposes that they split up. One team goes after Scylla, and the other tracks down Charyb. 

Knuckles and Shade must lead their team to track down Scylla and take his Chaos Emerald before the Nocturne travels through the wormhole and into their world! Knuckles has another interesting motive for splitting up the team: He wants to try to talk Ix into abandoning his evil plan! Knuckles must reach Ix before Shadow does!

Angel Island has fallen from the sky, and now a giant wormhole threatens to blot out the sun over Metropolis! Our heroes' only hope is to go into the wormhole to recover the Chaos Emeralds and the Master Emerald from the evil Ix!

Eggman has a rocket ship that could get our heroes up to the wormhole. Of course, before the rocket can survive travel to another dimension, Eggman and Tails must install a dimensional buffer. Eggman has one hidden away in his Hazard Vault. Unfortunately, it seems that not all the most dangerous robots escaped the Hazard Vault after the crash. Shadow and his team could be in danger.

The team has recovered one of the Chaos Emeralds, but they have a long way to go to recover all seven and the Master Emerald. Tails' sensors have detected Chaos Emeralds from Sectors Scylla and Charyb, as well as Ix's fortress, Nocturne. Unfortunately, a repulsor field surrounds Nocturne, so it's impossible to land anywhere near it.

Shadow and his friends have recovered Chaos Emeralds from both the N'rrgal and the Zoah and turned both races against Ix! The team is that much closer to defeating Ix and recovering the Master Emerald!
Ha ha ha ha ha! You may have damaged my new Egg Carrier, Shadow, but you'll never defeat me!
Well, I wouldn't take too much time sightseeing, Shadow. We have to save Knuckles!
Welcome back, Shadow! You've been gone a long time.
Hey, Shadow! I know you didn't want to help, but this is important!

Gizoids are ancient robots created four thousand years ago near the end of the Fourth Great Civilization. They were created to be the ultimate military robots, capable of destroying entire armies. It is believed that they were destroyed in the fall of the Fourth Great Civilization. 

The most famous Gizoid is Emerl, the only Gizoid to survive the Fourth Great Civilization's destruction. Discovered just over fifty years ago by Prof. Gerald Robotnik, Emerl was an ancient weapon that could mimic the powers and abilities of things around him. According to Prof. Robotnik's notes, Emerl was responsible for the destruction of the Fourth Great Civilization. 

Prof. Robotnik programmed Emerl with a "Soul" based on the personality of his granddaughter Maria Robotnik. Unfortunately, Emerl was prone to overload when he absorbed too many abilities, and when he absorbed too many of Robotnik's weapons and machines, he destroyed a large section of the Space Colony ARK, Robotnik's orbital space station. 

Years later, Eggman found Emerl the Gizoid and gave him a Chaos Emerald as an experiment. Emerl absorbed the Emerald, and Eggman threw him away, angered that he couldn't recover the Emerald.

Shadow later found Emerl, and Emerl bonded with him right away. Emerl slowly began to develop a personality and became a friend to Shadow and the rest of the team, but Eggman worked hard to capture the Gizoid. When Eggman finally came after him, Emerl went on a rampage, forcing Shadow to destroy him. Defeated, Emerl disappeared in a flash of light, leaving only shards of the Chaos Emeralds behind. The N'rrgal are a race of slime-like beings who live on the N'rrgal Colony in the Twilight Cage. Bitter enemies of the Zoah, the N'rrgal are energy-eaters known for their massive numbers and ability to reproduce faster than enemies can destroy them. 

Visitors to the N'rrgal Colony rarely see anything but the relatively simple and silent N'rrgal workers... until they try to cause trouble. Then some of the workers suddenly become warriors who fight with frightening ruthlessness. Stranger than that are the N'rrgal Swarms, creatures that are the result of many N'rrgal workers combining into one being, and the N'rrgal Queen, a highly intelligent N'rrgal that resembles a gigantic Swarm made up of dozens of combined workers. It seems as though anything that any N'rrgal knows, the Queen also knows, and vice versa, giving evidence of a kind of N'rrgal hive mind. 

When a N'rrgal worker gets too old, or even too bored of life, he goes to the spawning pools to rejoin the source, at which point two new young N'rrgal emerge, ready to work for the colony. In this way, the N'rrgal reproduce quickly in peacetime, and in wartime, workers volunteer to "spawn" as a service to the Queen.

The N'rrgal's ability to absorb energy is their main defense against their enemies, the Zoah. Along with their overwhelming numbers, this ability makes them valuable frontline soldiers in Ix’s upcoming war of conquest. Fortunately, Shadow and friends have convinced the N'rrgal to turn against Ix and help in the fight to recover the Master Emerald.

The Nocturnus Clan leader, Ix, has tried for a long time to find a way out of the Twilight Cage. The Twilight Cage is home to many strange races, including the Kron, the Zoah, the Voxai, and the N'rrgal. Each race lives on a floating planetoid, or colony, separated by a space-like dimensional void. The Nocturne, the stronghold of the Nocturnus Clan, stands on a colony in the center of the Twilight Cage. The Twilight Cage is further divided by the zones of Sector Scylla and Sector Charyb. 

Based on his translations of ancient Precursor tablets, the Nocturnus historian Nestor the Wise has theorized that the races of the Twilight Cage are there because they are dangerous and powerful. It's possible that all the races were brought to the Twilight Cage on purpose by a mysterious higher power that created the Twilight Cage as a prison of sorts. It also seems as if time moves differently in the Cage, such that a day in the Twilight Cage is like a year in some worlds and a minute in others. Signs point to a being named "Argus" as the supreme creator and ruler of the Twilight Cage. Nestor seemed to go a little mad and locked himself in his home when he read that last Precursor tablet.

The Twilight Cage operates on a different dimensional frequency from Shadow's world, so it can only be entered through the use of warp generators or wormholes. Thankfully, a wormhole to the Twilight Cage requires a level of power that only a relic such as the Master Emerald could generate.

The Voxai operate as one mind, and while there is little unrest, there is also little free will... or so it was believed. It seems that a Voxai named Thebes has broken free of the Overmind's control and seeks to free his people. If Shadow helps him, Thebes will make sure Shadow and his friends leave with the Chaos Emeralds that are somehow powering the Overmind!

Thebes asked the team to meet him at his home in the eastern areas of Voxai Colony Beta.

Each Emerald can float on its own power, but anyone who combines all seven of the Chaos Emeralds can command ultimate power. Many, including Shadow, Knuckles, Sonic, and others, can even use the power of the seven Chaos Emeralds to transform into Super versions of themselves!

No one knows where the Chaos Emeralds came from, but the ancient echidna civilizations knew of them and sought their secrets. Even the Fourth Great Civilization, the mysterious civilization that created Emerl and the Gizoids, experimented with Chaos Emeralds. Until recently, the Chaos Emeralds were locked away in hidden places in Shadow's World. The sinister Nocturnus Clan Echidnas, led by Ix, stole them and took them into the Twilight Cage, an alternate dimension where the clan has been imprisoned, never aging, for thousands of years.

The Nocturnus Clan are a nation of echidnas who lived in Shadow's world in ancient times. Only the Knuckles Clan, led by the powerful mystic Pachacamac, could stand in their way.

Until recently, only legends survived of the powerful ancient echidna race that once nearly controlled  the world, but recent events have revealed that the Nocturnus Clan has existed all along, locked away in an alternate dimension called the Twilight Cage.

The Nocturnus historian, Nestor the Wise, revealed that the Nocturnus invented the Gizoids, including Emerl, leading to the suggestion that the Nocturnus Clan actually was the Fourth Great Civilization proposed by Prof. Gerald Robotnik.

The assault on the Nocturnus Clan has begun! The team splits up: Shadow and Knuckles lead one group, and Tails and Eggman lead another.

Shadow, Knuckles, and team were fighting for their lives on Angel Island and called for help! The teleporter in Eggman's Underground base can be reconfigured to send the team to Angel Island... but they must get back there and make it work!
What do you want, Shadow?

The Zoah are a race of warlike energy giants who live on the Zoah Colony in the Twilight Cage. Bent on conquest and domination, the Zoah seek endlessly to destroy their hated neighbors, the N'rrgal. 

Zoah society is highly stratified, with a clear division between citizens and non-citizens. While citizens enjoy many rights that non-citizens don't, it seems that anyone can become a Zoah citizen if they can pass the rigorous citizenship test. There's a further division in quality of life between citizens and members of the Zoah Military. The Military are almost the Zoah noble caste and enjoy respect and luxury well beyond anything available to basic citizens. 

At the top of the chain sits General Raxos and his elite guard. This emphasis on military might and conquest is precisely what made the Zoah attractive to Ix and the Nocturne. Thankfully, Shadow and friends defeated General Raxos in a challenge and convinced him to end his alliance with the Nocturnus, and now the Zoah are turning their military might against Ix.
This might be a good time to save your game, Shadow!
Make up your mind, Shadow!
Shadow, we have a problem. The ship landed all right, but we're completely out of power, and I think the Dimensional Buffer is shot.

Shadow and Knuckles' team must escape the Underground and get to the surface to clear the way for Tails and Eggman's team.
We have a difficult fight ahead of us, Shadow. I go with you knowing that Ix will most likely kill me.

Shadow has brought some Nocturnus Tech to Rouge, but she needs more. He should bring the Nocturnus Tech to her in the Cyclone whenever he gets some from fallen Nocturnus enemies!

Rouge the Bat is an enigma. As a a spy, a freelance treasure hunter, and a member of Sonic the Hedgehog's Team Dark, Rouge's motivations are always in question. In truth, she's usually just out for herself.

Rouge is a confident, fearless, and flirty young woman, the only member of the team who uses her looks to get what she wants. Her carefree and playful attitude is fun for some and annoying to others, but she has been known to set it aside to help Sonic and Team Dark achieve their objectives. She gets along with Shadow well enough, but she always had a sort of rivalry with Amy Rose. There's a sort of unstated connection between Rouge and Knuckles that neither is overly willing to explore.

Rouge can fly as quickly as Tails or Knuckles, but not as quickly as Sonic or Shadow can run. She is also skilled at the art of stealth, always on the lookout for gems and other valuable things to make her own. As a spy, Rouge is trained in combat and infiltration, which she uses to help her less stealthy friends.

In combat, Rouge has low damage power and low armor, but she gets to attack twice per round, thanks to her innate quickness. Rouge's abilities to weaken and distract foes, along with her skills at stealing items from enemies, make her an asset in combat.

The mystic Knuckles Clan lived in what is now known as Mystic Ruins. It is believed that this move was born out of desperation in the face of his clan's destruction at the hands of a rival clan. Knuckles the Echidna is the only surviving member of the Knuckles Clan. The rest of his people died out in the centuries since Pachacamac's disaster.

As a former denizen of the Twilight Cage, she is very knowledgeable about the races and places in that alternate dimension, and she is willing to help the team by telling them what she knows of Ix's secrets. She is quite impressed with both Shadow and Knuckles, and she fights alongside them to redeem herself for unknowingly contributing to Ix's plans for world domination.
